closed_found.name_ja: TRIO ラジオ会館店

closed_found.name_ja: 東京アニメセンター（秋葉原UDX 4F）

closed_found.name_ja: 夢織屋 秋葉原1号店（旧館）
closed_found.note: Heisei-retro anime/game goods shop; ceased trading and moved its stock to a warehouse. The business continues at 夢織屋 秋葉原1号店（新館, 福信ビル）and 夢織屋キッズ, both listed as open. No exact final day published. Source: https://akiba-pc.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/news/2068811.html

closed_found.name_ja: リバティー 秋葉原6号店（秋葉原スーパービル）
closed_found.note: Buy-only counter for anime goods and figures in 秋葉原スーパービル (NAVITIME gives 外神田1-11-5); merged into the nearby リバティー秋葉原2号店 around mid-March 2024. Source: https://akiba-pc.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/news/1568861.html

closed_found.name_ja: TX PLAZA 秋葉原

closed_found.name_ja: ノンストップ

closed_found.name_ja: 森の里くらぶ

closed_found.name_ja: レオナルドLG 2号店
closed_found.note: Used plastic-model shop at 外神田6-4-12 神田中沢ビル 4F. Closed 2025-11-19; the main レオナルドLG (台東区上野3-3-4) still trades. OSM node/4950063751 (35.7031,139.771301) is stale.

closed_found.name_ja: e-sports SQUARE AKIHABARA（OSM: e-Sorts Square AKIHABARA）
closed_found.note: Japan's first esports-dedicated venue, in the 計測器ワールド / 橋爪ビル cluster at 外神田3-2 next to Twin Box GARAGE (OSM node 11843168373, level 1 = 2F, last surveyed 2024-04-24). Ceased operation 30 April 2025 after 14 years; it ran the weekly Fighter's Crossover -AKIBA- meets. Would have been an arcade-category record had it survived. Source: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/E-sports_SQUARE

closed_found.name_ja: げっちゅ屋 あきば店
closed_found.note: Bishojo-game and anime-goods shop on 中央通り, 3F of 千住ビル7 (the OSM node 6235897731 at level 2 reverse-geocodes to 恵光ビル, 外神田3丁目 — the two building names conflict and neither is now verifiable). Closed 31 Aug 2024 after about 20 years. Would in any case have been borderline for the product, since part of its range was adult PC-game related. Source: https://akiba-pc.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/news/1609135.html

closed_found.name_ja: イゼルローンフォートレス
closed_found.note: Legend of the Galactic Heroes themed dining cafe at 台東区上野2-1-9 GAOH黒門ビル2F, 76 m from 上野御徒町 station. A 【ダイニングカフェ・イゼルローンフォートレス】閉店のお知らせ notice was published and the online store closed 31 Dec 2025; the exact last day of the cafe itself is not stated in the sources I could read. It had 銀河帝国エリア and 同盟エリア seating. Also sat at the far north edge of the box, past where the Akihabara district really ends, so it was a scope call as well.
